# IModContext.IsModLoaded method

Whether the mod with that Id is loaded. The mods listed in this mod's manifest's `Dependencies`, optional ones included, load before it, so the answer for them is final from its [`OnLoad`](../IMod/OnLoad.md) on. Other mods may load after it.

